relations.subject: cbl:replicator
relations.evidence: Couchbase Lite client applications use a Replicator process to synchronize their local database, through a Sync Gateway database, to a remote Couchbase Server database (server- or cloud-based)

relations.subject: cbl:pull-replication
relations.evidence:
Pull Replication

This is the process by which clients running Couchbase Lite download database changes from the remote (server) source database to the local target database

relations.subject: cbl:push-replication
relations.evidence:
Push Replication

This is the process by which clients running Couchbase Lite upload database changes from the local source database to the remote (server) target database

notable_absence.finding: This short (68-line) page is purely a definitional/navigational page: it names the Replicator, Pull Replication and Push Replication, shows one architecture figure, and otherwise only links out to the per-language Couchbase Lite replication pages (Android/C/C#/Java/Objective-C/Swift). It states no protocol, port, authentication, or configuration detail of its own - all of that is deferred to the per-language CBL pages, which are out of scope for this Sync Gateway batch.

cross_component_finding: This page is the cleanest single statement in the batch of Sync Gateway's mediating role between Couchbase Lite and Couchbase Server: 'through a Sync Gateway database, to a remote Couchbase Server database.' No new sgw: mechanics are introduced beyond the already-promoted sgw:database concept.
cross_product_finding: The page is explicitly Couchbase-Lite-facing and mints three cbl: concepts (Replicator, Pull Replication, Push Replication) that had no prior registry presence despite being fundamental CBL vocabulary - most prior Sync Gateway batches approached sync from the Sync-Gateway or Server side, not the client-app side. The six per-language 'Related Couchbase Lite content' links (Android, C, C#, Java, Objective-C, Swift) were treated as boilerplate navigation and not captured as individual seeAlso relations.
